header: Managing a data source in Amazon OpenSearch Service
content:
Managing your data source is an important part of maintaining the reliability, availability, and
performance of direct query data sources and your other AWS solutions. AWS provides the
following tools to monitor, report when something is wrong, and take automatic actions when
appropriate.
Topics
• Monitoring with CloudWatch metrics data sources
• Enabling and disabling data sources
• Monitoring with AWS Budget
• Deleting a data source
